name: AI-Driven Software Maintenance and Evolution
description: Research on applying machine learning, deep learning, and search-based techniques to automate software maintenance tasks such as refactoring, technical debt detection, and code smell identification.

name: Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) Quality and Evolution
description: Empirical studies and tool support for understanding, maintaining, and evolving Infrastructure-as-Code scripts (Terraform, Ansible, etc.), including dependency management, code review practices, and AWS provider updates.

name: Large Language Models for Software Engineering
description: Investigating the capabilities and limitations of LLMs for software engineering tasks including code change intent classification, code review, and automated software development.

name: Search-Based Software Engineering (SBSE)
description: Applying evolutionary computation, genetic programming, and multi-objective optimization to solve software engineering problems such as test generation, code review prediction, and fault prediction.

name: Empirical Studies on Developer Practices
description: Data-driven studies using mining software repositories (MSR) methods to understand how developers work, including Stack Overflow analysis, GitHub Actions usage, and microservices deployment trends.
